The {PAWN_title} named {PAWN_nameDef} has emerged from a cryptosleep casket and is joining the colony.\n\n{PAWN_nameFull}, the brilliant mind behind the creation of the ARC generator, brings a wealth of knowledge and experience. Across this planet, {PAWN_nameDef} tirelessly developed countless ARC prototypes, though many succumbed to neglect or external catastrophes. Despite these setbacks, {PAWN_nameDef} possesses unparalleled expertise in constructing, repairing, maintaining, and upgrading all known ARC generator types, including the advanced nuclear and geothermal variants. Moreover, {PAWN_nameDef} can attempt to salvage critical ARC components from advanced components, a skill that could prove invaluable in building or enhancing your colony’s own ARC generator.
Disable the need of a steam vent to build an ARC
By default, you will need a steam vent present in the map to build your ARC. With this mod option active, you can build them anywhere. Useful for gravships, for example.
ARC upgrade timer multiplier (lower means faster)

When upgrading the ARC, there are a series of time periods the player needs to respect before being allowed to do the upgrades (eg "the ARC needs to run for X days in this mode before being upgraded"). This setting will apply a multiplier to those periods. Bear in mind a lower number means things will go faster. A higher number will mean the ARC will take longer.
ARC upgrade fuel multiplier (lower means less fuel needed)

When upgrading the ARC, there are some times when the player needs to burn a given amount of fuel before being allowed to do the upgrades (eg "the ARC needs to burn X wood before being upgraded"). This setting will apply a multiplier to those amount. Bear in mind a lower number means less fuel is needed. A higher number will mean more fuel.

Advanced reactor chamber, ARC in short, produces electricity from geothermal steam geysers. It’s an advanced generator type that can be upgraded to accept other fuel types, unlocking powerful new abilities. Must be placed on a steam geyser.

Chemfuel-powered advanced reactor chamber, ARC in short, produces electricity from geothermal steam geysers and chemfuel burned in a gigantic engine. The engine requires regular maintenance, and lack of it can result in a critical breakdown of the ARC components. Originally designed by {InventorFullName}, these ARCs are incredibly rare, but also versatile and powerful. It’s an advanced generator type that can be upgraded to accept other fuel types, unlocking powerful new abilities. It can be put into an overdrive mode, burning more fuel but generating more power. It can also be tuned to increase the power generation even further. Must be placed on a steam geyser and can only be constructed and upgraded by colonists who have studied the ancient ARC generators.

The more uranium is present in the core, the faster it breaks down, but it also generates more power. If uranium ever runs out, the reactor will shut down and will need to be refilled with a large quantity of uranium to restart. The core suffers wear and tear with each uranium unit broken down, and will require continuous maintenance, as lack of it will result in a catastrophic nuclear detonation. Originally designed by {InventorFullName}, these ARCs are incredibly rare, but also versatile and powerful. It’s an advanced generator type that can be upgraded to accept other fuel types, unlocking powerful new abilities. It can be put into an overdrive mode, burning more fuel but generating more power. Must be placed on a steam geyser and can only be constructed and upgraded by colonists who have studied a husk of a nuclear ARC generator.
